title: Read the mini's crash reports of the last 12 h (diag-crashes.json): app, build, exception, the crashing thread's top frames
why: A crash on a fleet mini (a Problem Reporter window, lead 10:5xZ) is classified from its own report: a product crash or the harness ending the app. The step only reads ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports.

steps.title: the app answers, the daemon agrees and the window is not blank (the journey's three evidence kinds)
